process_data_with_helperclass: create a HelperClass instance and call process_data to process and update internal data
get_result_from_helperclass: create a HelperClass instance and call get_result to retrieve the processed data as a string
process_data_with_dataprocessor: call the DataProcessor.process static method to get a list of integers for data processing
internal_process_helperclass: create a HelperClass instance and call _internal_process to return the internal data list
internal_process_dataprocessor: create a DataProcessor instance and call _internal_process to get the processing status message
